title: Find The Distance Value Between Two Arrays
description: Given two integer arrays arr1 and arr2, and an integer d, return the distance value between the two arrays. The distance value is the number of elements arr1[i] such that there is no element arr2[j] where |arr1[i] - arr2[j]| <= d.

steps.note: Sort arr2 to enable binary search.
Iterate through arr1, starting with x = 4.
Binary search for 4 in [1, 9, 10] with d=2. mid is 9.
Check |4 - 9| <= 2. It is 5, which is > 2. Narrow search.
Target 4 is smaller than 9, move high.
No element found within range for 4. count becomes 1.
